name: AURAGENT Evidence Fabric — completion layer
security_invariants: raw evaluator reasoning is not exported by the evidence admin API
forensic replay is read-only and never executes agent actions
distributed writer sequence cannot fork or skip
external anchoring submits commitments rather than raw evidence
external anchor endpoints are HTTPS-only and host-allowlisted
redirects and automatic retries are disabled
build_policy: Implementation first; comprehensive integration, database, dashboard and deployment verification deferred to final AURAGENT verification.
